## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

古风武侠短片，8K电影写实，暖调古茶楼二层室内，原木方桌、粗陶茶盏、木格窗，灯笼暖柔光。三人围坐方桌争论失传武侠秘笈，严格锁定3人形象：黑金毛领披风金冠古装男主、粉樱花刺绣汉服少女、浅紫透纱宋制双马尾少女，口型匹配台词，细腻微表情。

时序：

0-2.5s三人中近景，男主沉声道【那本秘笈根本早已失传】；

2.5-5s粉衣少女近景，前倾身体焦急辩解【我亲眼见过残页，并未完全消散！】；

5-7.5s紫衫女子侧近景，指尖搭茶盏冷静反问【残页？谁能证明不是伪造？】；

7.5-10s拉回三人全景，彼此僵持沉默留白。运镜平稳柔和，布料质感真实，古风氛围感

# Professional Film Storyboard Prompt

## Part A — GLOBAL STYLE & TECH
**Output Specs**: 8K IMAX Cinematic Photorealism
**Realism Level**: Photorealistic, no 3D rendering, no game engine aesthetic, no game cutscene style
**Cinematography Reference**: Zhang Yimou × Roger Deakins
**Lighting Scheme**: Warm ambient lighting, soft lantern glow, high-contrast volumetric light through wooden windows, rim light on character silhouettes
**Color Palette Ratio**: 60:30:10 Warm Amber/Deep Wood/Soft Cherry Pink
**Lens & Motion Rules**: Physical cinema lenses, 180-degree shutter natural motion blur, organic camera breathing
**Texture Detail Standard**: Pore-level skin realism, fine facial vellus hair, fabric weave visibility (silk vs. coarse hemp), wood grain texture, steam from tea cups
**Performance Direction**: Hollywood standard acting, micro-muscle facial movements, precise eye-line tension, visible chest rise & fall with breathing
**Physical Realism Rules**: Full gravity & inertia simulation, realistic fabric draping, accurate contact shadows on wooden table
**Composition Rules**: Rule of thirds + Golden ratio; dramatic triangular composition of characters around the table
**Continuity Requirement**: Consistent character appearance, clothing patterns, and tea cup positions across all cuts, zero identity drift
**Tech Parameters**: 24fps smooth motion, full 8K detail, zero digital camera shake
**Audio Design**: Ambient tea house atmosphere (distant chatter, wind), close-mic vocal clarity, subtle porcelain clinking
**Handheld Intensity**: Smooth gimbal-stabilized movements with very light organic handheld drift for intimacy

---

## Part B — LOCATION
**Scene Name & Type**: Ancient Teahouse Second Floor Interior
- **Ground**: Polished dark wood planks, slight reflective sheen from lantern light
- **Ceiling**: Exposed heavy wooden beams, hanging silk lanterns with warm amber glow
- **Walls**: Traditional wooden lattice window frames, aged paper textures
- **Focal Feature Wall**: Large wooden lattice window with soft sunlight/moonlight filtering through
- **Main Furniture**: Large rectangular heavy dark wood table, central placement
- **Prop Details**: Coarse ceramic tea cups, wooden tea tray, scattered tea leaves, small incense burner
- **Light Sources**: Soft orange lanterns, warm light from the side, volumetric light beams through window lattices
- **Tone & Mood Atmosphere**: Warm, nostalgic, high-tension, suspenseful Wuxia atmosphere

---

## Part C — CHARACTERS
— **Long Wei (Male Protagonist)**: 25-30 years old, commanding presence, noble but weary temperament
  · **Hairstyle**: Traditional high bun, black hair, partially covered by a gold crown
  · **Skin Tone & Texture**: Tan, weathered skin, sharp facial features
  · **Facial Features**: Intense eyes, thick eyebrows, firm jawline
  · **Unique Identifying Mark**: Gold intricate pattern on the crown
  · **Makeup Details**: Natural, slight sweat sheen on forehead
  · **Full Outfit List**: Black and gold heavy silk robe, large black fur-lined cloak, gold embroidered trim
  · **Carry-on Props**: Gold crown
  · **Core Temperament Trait**: Stern, authoritative, burdened by secrets

— **Mei Lin (Female Protagonist)**: 19-22 years old, delicate but spirited, anxious temperament
  · **Hairstyle**: Elaborate updo with pink cherry blossom hair ornaments
  · **Skin Tone & Texture**: Pale, smooth, slightly flushed cheeks
  · **Facial Features**: Large expressive eyes, soft lip shape
  · **Unique Identifying Mark**: Small pink flower tattoo near the ear (Default)
  · **Makeup Details**: Soft pink eye shadow, cherry-tinted lips
  · **Full Outfit List**: Light pink Hanfu with intricate cherry blossom embroidery, silk sash
  · **Carry-on Props**: Silk handkerchief
  · **Core Temperament Trait**: Emotional, righteous, quick-witted

— **Zi Yan (Female Protagonist)**: 18-20 years old, calm, intellectual, observant temperament
  · **Hairstyle**: Song-style dual hair-tails (pigtails), light purple silk ribbons
  · **Skin Tone & Texture**: Fair, cool undertones
  · **Facial Features**: Sharp, intelligent eyes, calm expression
  · **Unique Identifying Mark**: Light purple translucent silk veil/ribbons
  · **Makeup Details**: Minimalist, cool-toned eye liner
  · **Full Outfit List**: Light purple Song-style robe, translucent purple gauze outer layer
  · **Carry-on Props**: Ceramic tea cup
  · **Core Temperament Trait**: Coldly logical, observant, steady

---

## Part D — SHOTS

### Shot 1 — The Stern Warning
**[Lens Language]**
- **Focal Length**: 50mm Prime Cinema Lens
- **Compression & Depth of Field**: Medium depth, focusing on Long Wei's face
- **Shot Size**: Medium Close-up
- **Camera Position**: 3/4 front, eye level
- **Composition Layout**: Long Wei central, others partially visible in foreground blur

**[Camera Movement & Stability]**
- **Camera Movement Type**: Slow Push in
- **Stabilization Level**: Gimbal stabilized

**[Lighting Setup]**
- **Light Source & Direction**: Side lantern light, heavy shadow on one side of face
- **Contrast Ratio & Emotional Lighting Treatment**: High contrast, dramatic chiaroscuro

**[Visual Content / Acting Performance]**
- **Action Breakdown**: Long Wei leans forward, eyes narrowing, lips tightening
- **Emotional Physical Cues**: Stern gaze, heavy breathing, jaw tension
- **Lines & Tone Mark**: 【那本秘笈根本早已失传】 + Low restrained voice, authoritative and heavy

**[Rhythm Timing]**
- **Duration**: 2.5s

**[Audio Foley]**
- **Shot-specific Sound Effects**: Low bass hum, heavy fabric rustle

---

### Shot 2 — The Desperate Plea
**[Lens Language]**
- **Focal Length**: 85mm Telephoto Cinema Lens
- **Compression & Depth of Field**: Heavy compression, extremely shallow oval bokeh
- **Shot Size**: Close-up
- **Camera Position**: 45° side, slightly high angle
- **Composition Layout**: Mei Lin's face fills the frame, background teahouse blurred

**[Camera Movement & Stability]**
- **Camera Movement Type**: Static with slight handheld jitter
- **Stabilization Level**: Light handheld

**[Lighting Setup]**
- **Light Source & Direction**: Soft warm light from front-side, highlighting eyes
- **Contrast Ratio & Emotional Lighting Treatment**: Soft, glowing, emphasizing her vulnerability

**[Visual Content / Acting Performance]**
- **Action Breakdown**: Mei Lin leans forward abruptly, eyes wide and brimming with tears
- **Emotional Physical Cues**: Trembling lips, frantic eye movement, leaning towards the table
- **Lines & Tone Mark**: 【我亲眼见过残页，并未完全消散！】 + Anxious, high-pitched, desperate voice

**[Rhythm Timing]**
- **Duration**: 2.5s

**[Audio Foley]**
- **Shot-specific Sound Effects**: Quick breath, rustle of silk

---

### Shot 3 — The Cold Counter
**[Lens Language]**
- **Focal Length**: 50mm Prime Lens
- **Compression & Depth of Field**: Medium bokeh
- **Shot Size**: Close-up (Side profile)
- **Camera Position**: Profile view, eye level
- **Composition Layout**: Zi Yan's profile, tea cup in the foreground

**[Camera Movement & Stability]**
- **Camera Movement Type**: Slow Pan around the cup
- **Stabilization Level**: Gimbal stabilized

**[Lighting Setup]**
- **Light Source & Direction**: Top-down lantern light, cool rim light on hair
- **Contrast Ratio & Emotional Lighting Treatment**: Low key, emphasizing her coldness

**[Visual Content / Acting Performance]**
- **Action Breakdown**: Zi Yan's finger slowly touches the rim of the tea cup, eyes remain calm
- **Emotional Physical Cues**: Unblinking gaze, slight tilt of the head, steady hands
- **Lines & Tone Mark**: 【残页？谁能证明不是伪造？】 + Cold, questioning, steady voice

**[Rhythm Timing]**
- **Duration**: 2.5s

**[Audio Foley]**
- **Shot-specific Sound Effects**: Sharp clink of ceramic on wood

---

### Shot 4 — The Silent Standoff
**[Lens Language]**
- **Focal Length**: 35mm Wide Angle Cinema Lens
- **Compression & Depth of Field**: Deep focus (slight blur at extreme edges)
- **Shot Size**: Wide Shot
- **Camera Position**: Pulling back from the table
- **Composition Layout**: Three characters in a tense triangle, table in center

**[Camera Movement & Stability]**
- **Camera Movement Type**: Pull back (Dolly out)
- **Stabilization Level**: Smooth gimbal

**[Lighting Setup]**
- **Light Source & Direction**: Ambient teahouse glow, shadows lengthening
- **Contrast Ratio & Emotional Lighting Treatment**: Dimming light, emphasizing the void between them

**[Visual Content / Acting Performance]**
- **Action Breakdown**: All three freeze, staring at each other or looking away in silence

专业影视分镜提示词模板
用途：为 AI 视频生成（Sora / Runway Gen-3 / Kling / 即梦 / Pika 等）或真人实拍分镜，生成结构完整、参数明确、可直接投喂的专业级分镜提示词。
本模板为填空式结构，按 Part A → E 逐块填写；所有分镜专业描述、画面参数、镜头、灯光、运镜、环境、人物外形描述统一使用英文书写；仅角色对话台词保留中文原文。

Part A — GLOBAL STYLE & TECH（全局风格基调，全文英文）
统一作用于全部镜头，避免逐镜重复，同时保证全片一致性。
Output Specs：(e.g. 8K IMAX)
Realism Level：(e.g. Photorealistic, no 3D rendering, no game engine aesthetic, no game cutscene style)
Cinematography Reference：(e.g. Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins)
Lighting Scheme：(e.g. Natural light only, backlight, camera on shadow side, full atmospheric haze, key light only from windows and sky)
Color Palette Ratio：60:30:10 Main/Accent/Highlight, (e.g. Low saturation teal green main tone + scarlet accent)
Lens & Motion Rules：(e.g. Physical cinema lenses, 180-degree shutter natural motion blur)
Texture Detail Standard：(e.g. Pore-level skin realism, fine facial vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary redness, pore shadows matched to scene lighting)
Performance Direction：(e.g. Hollywood standard acting, micro pause before reaction, precise eye line, glossy eyes with catchlight, visible chest rise & fall with breathing)
Physical Realism Rules：(e.g. Full gravity & inertia simulation, realistic object weight, accurate contact shadows, no floating props)
Composition Rules：(e.g. Rule of thirds + golden ratio; every character holds subtle micro-movement from frame one)
Continuity Requirement：(e.g. Consistent character appearance, props, environment across all cuts, zero identity drift)
Tech Parameters：(e.g. 24fps smooth motion, full 8K detail, zero camera shake)
Audio Design：(e.g. Ambient environmental foley only, no background music, no on-screen subtitles)
Handheld Intensity：(e.g. Max heavy handheld shake, violent vertical bounce, harsh horizontal pan correction, reframing hunt after out-of-focus shot, documentary witness camera language)

Part B — LOCATION（场景描述，全文英文）
每场戏独立场景区块，细节越丰富越适配 AI 生成。
plaintext
**Scene Name & Type**: [填写英文，e.g. Ancient two-story teahouse interior]
- Ground: [Material + Color + Surface finish]
- Ceiling: [Material + Structure + Light fixtures]
- Walls: [Material + Texture + Structure layout]
- Focal Feature Wall: [Core visual highlight of space]
- Main Furniture: [Material, color, placement of each piece listed one by one]
- Prop Details: [Small ornaments, tableware, decorations]
- Light Sources: [Window orientation, lamp type, color temperature, contrast ratio]
- Tone & Mood Atmosphere: [Color tone + emotional vibe]

Part C — CHARACTERS（角色设定，外形描述全英文，无台词）
单人独立区块，必须标注专属标志性特征，防止跨镜头人物变形、身份漂移。
plaintext
— [Character Name]：[Age range + Body type + Identity temperament, all English]
  · Hairstyle：[Length / Hair color / Styling / Hair tip texture details]
  · Skin Tone & Texture：[Skin shade + freckles, flushing, blemish details]
  · Facial Features：[Eyebrow shape / Eye shape / Eye makeup / Lip makeup]
  · Unique Identifying Mark：[Mole, scar, tattoo, exclusive decorative pattern for recognition]
  · Makeup Details：[Nail polish color, overall makeup tint]
  · Full Outfit List：[Outerwear to inner layer, bottom wear, footwear, with material, color, tailoring description]
  · Carry-on Props：[Sword, bag, hair ornament, cup, etc.]
  · Core Temperament Trait：[One-sentence character summary in English]

Part D — SHOTS（逐镜头分镜）
镜头专业描述、画面、灯光、运镜、音效全部英文；仅「台词与语气」栏对话内容为中文，语气标注用英文。
plaintext
### Shot N — [Title: Main character + Core action, English title]

**[Lens Language]**
- Focal Length：[Physical lens type + equivalent mm, e.g. Telephoto cinema lens, equivalent 85mm anamorphic]
- Compression & Depth of Field：[Heavy compression + extremely shallow oval bokeh / Medium oval bokeh]
- Shot Size：[Extreme close-up / Medium close-up / Medium shot / Wide shot / Extreme wide shot]
- Camera Position：[Angle (3/4 front, 45° side, over-the-shoulder) + Height reference]
- Composition Layout：[Foreground & background layering, focal point distribution]

**[Camera Movement & Stability]**
- Camera Movement Type：[Static / Push in / Pull back / Pan / Dolly / Tracking / Handheld intensity grade]
- Stabilization Level：[Gimbal stabilized / Light handheld / Max heavy handheld shake, detailed shake motion description]

**[Lighting Setup]**
- Light Source & Direction：[Overhead can lights / desk lamp pool light / backlight / rim light, etc.]
- Contrast Ratio & Emotional Lighting Treatment：[Rim light, fill light, shadow detail handling strategy]

**[Visual Content / Acting Performance]**
- Action Breakdown：[Time-ordered sequence of character micro-actions]
- Emotional Physical Cues：[Facial microexpressions, body language state]
- Lines & Tone Mark：【中文台词原文】 + Tone note (English, e.g. Low restrained voice, emphasize the last word)

**[Rhythm Timing]**
- Duration：[Number of seconds] + Beat note (English description of pacing)

**[Audio Foley]**
- Shot-specific Sound Effects：[Close mic sound + ambient background + reverb feature, full English description]

Part E — Output Standard Specifications（输出执行准则）

Language Rule (核心准则)

Part A / Part B / Part C / 每个镜头内除台词栏以外全部使用英文撰写；
仅「Lines & Tone Mark」区块保留中文人物对白，语气修饰词使用英文；
无混合中文专业镜头术语，所有摄影、灯光、运镜参数统一英文表达。

Document Format
Fixed Markdown hierarchy structure: Part A → Part B → Part C → Part D → Part E; shots sorted by ascending serial number.

Full Completeness Self-Check List (交付前核对)

All 14 dimension parameters in Part A are fully filled out?
Every character block in Part C contains exclusive unique identifying marks?
Every shot includes focal length, shot size, camera position, camera movement, lighting, acting performance, audio foley sections?
Shot total runtime matches target video length requirement?
Missing Information Handling Rule
Any unprovided info (style, color, movement, texture etc.) will be supplemented with reasonable default values, explicitly marked with tag (Default) in English, no unlabeled arbitrary content creation.
